name: Evafresh Ultra Cleaner
shortDescription: Heavy-duty cleaner that cuts tough grease and grime.
description: When everyday cleaners aren't enough, Evafresh Ultra Cleaner cuts through heavy grease and built-up grime on cookers, extractor hoods, garage floors and workshop surfaces.
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the ingredient list exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Dilute as directed for heavy-duty cleaning.
Apply, leave briefly, scrub and rinse well.
safety: Keep out of reach of children. Wear gloves. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Do not mix with other cleaning products. Test on a small hidden area first.
